scope: Registry entries are not execution support. Reference-only integrations are unimplemented and untested in this workbench.

items.name: ε-greedy + sample-average estimates
protocol_requirements: Declare arm distribution, exploration schedule and tie breaking.
Count every interaction in lifetime mean reward; no frozen evaluation for the tutorial.
caveats: A stationary bandit teaching baseline; this small implementation is not an author-code reproduction.

items.name: ε-greedy + constant step size
protocol_requirements: Tune alpha on development lifetimes and preserve unseen test lifetimes.
Log phase only for analysis; never pass the hidden switch schedule to the learner.
caveats: Tracking a switching bandit does not establish neural continual-RL efficacy.

items.name: Tabular Q-learning
protocol_requirements: Test the max-action target and terminal bootstrap mask by hand.
Report behavior return separately from frozen greedy evaluation.
caveats: The builtin runs the local cliff_grid teaching environment only.

items.name: Tabular Sarsa
protocol_requirements: Use the action actually sampled for the next on-policy target.
Declare epsilon, tie breaking and time-limit bootstrap behavior.
caveats: The builtin runs the local cliff_grid teaching environment only.

items.name: Policy/value iteration
protocol_requirements: Record the complete transition model, reward convention, discount and convergence tolerance.
Compare tiny MDP solutions to hand-calculated values.
caveats: A known-model oracle is an implementation diagnostic, not a sample-budget competitor.

items.name: TD(λ) and true-online TD(λ)
protocol_requirements: Record accumulating/replacing/Dutch trace semantics.
Test forward/backward equivalence under the matching algorithm and assumptions.
caveats: Different trace variants are different methods; do not silently interchange them.

items.name: Gradient TD / TDC
protocol_requirements: Record behavior/target policies, importance ratios and auxiliary-variable update order.
Use a divergence counterexample plus a realizable prediction problem.
caveats: Prediction convergence conditions do not establish nonlinear control stability.

items.name: Differential / average-reward actor-critic
protocol_requirements: State the continuing objective, reference normalization and average-reward estimate.
Check reward-offset behavior and update clocks.
caveats: Discounted return and average reward define different objectives.

items.name: DQN
protocol_requirements: Record replay ratio, target synchronization, frame counting and action repeat.
Unit-test stop-gradient targets, selected-action indexing and terminal masks.
caveats: A neural Q-network without matching replay and target rules is not a faithful DQN reproduction.

items.name: Rainbow
protocol_requirements: Declare each component and its ablation.
Test categorical projection, n-step boundaries and prioritized-replay weights.
caveats: A partial Rainbow variant must list omitted or changed components.

items.name: PPO via Stable-Baselines3
protocol_requirements: Pin SB3, PyTorch and Gymnasium versions.
Record rollout length, minibatch schedule, advantage normalization, clipping and actual consumed steps.
Use independent evaluation RNG and freeze normalization statistics during diagnostic evaluation.
caveats: Only CartPole-v1 is part of the initial adapter scope; no general PPO benchmark claim.
SB3 may require full rollouts; the runner must reject or declare budget rounding instead of hiding extra steps.

items.name: Soft Actor-Critic
protocol_requirements: Record entropy-temperature adaptation, target entropy and reward scaling.
Test tanh log-probability correction, action bounds and critic-target masking.
caveats: Different SAC editions differ in value networks and temperature updates.

items.name: Twin Delayed DDPG
protocol_requirements: Separate exploration noise from target smoothing noise.
Test twin minimum, delayed actor clock and target updates.
caveats: Actor-update counts and environment-step budgets are distinct.

items.name: DreamerV3
protocol_requirements: Account for real transitions, model updates and imagined transitions separately.
Record world-model training, sequence boundaries, latent resets and reward transformations.
caveats: World-model predictive quality alone does not demonstrate control benefit.

items.name: TD-MPC2
protocol_requirements: Count action-selection planning compute and model learning separately.
Pin action horizon, optimization iterations, model ensemble and warm starts.
caveats: Equal interaction budgets can hide unequal planning cost.

items.name: Conservative Q-Learning
protocol_requirements: Pin dataset bytes/version, reward transformation and action support.
Separate offline development, policy selection and any online evaluation interaction.
caveats: Online validation access changes the information and interaction budget.

items.name: Stream-AC / Stream-X family
protocol_requirements: Pin paper version, author branch and exact commit.
Record true update direction, normalization order, eligibility traces and actual optimizer.
Compare lifetime raw reward and all persistent state costs.
caveats: The 2024 and 2026 versions differ; never merge them under an unspecified Stream-AC label.
Author repository license must be reviewed before any reuse; no upstream code is bundled here.

items.name: Metatrace Actor-Critic
protocol_requirements: Specify scalar, vector or mixed variant, trace/TD derivative, entropy and normalization.
Label equation-level ports separately from author-code reproduction.
caveats: A generic adaptive learning rate is not a complete Metatrace baseline.

items.name: Intentional Actor-Critic
protocol_requirements: Preserve the functional target, diagonal scaling, trace rules, initialization and preprocessing.
Tune functional eta in its own units rather than matching an SGD step-size number.
caveats: Intentional-Q is a separate method and cannot be relabeled Intentional-AC.
Inspect the exact source license before copying or redistributing; this entry links only.

items.name: Greedy Actor-Critic
protocol_requirements: Specify proposal distribution, sampled candidate count, elite rule, critic and entropy convention.
Compare operator and step-size controller in a factorial mechanism panel.
caveats: The full method uses replay/minibatches; a no-replay port is a new adaptation.

items.name: StreamRTU
protocol_requirements: Pin recurrence, sensitivity injection and any encoder-gradient approximation.
Count hidden state, sensitivity memory and per-step computation.
caveats: A detach visible in code does not by itself prove all historical sensitivity was removed.

items.name: Continual Backpropagation intervention
protocol_requirements: Pair with a named base RL algorithm and declare replacement schedule and utility estimate.
Specify reset treatment for weights, optimizer, traces and recurrent state.
caveats: This is a plasticity intervention, not a standalone control algorithm.
Relearning speed and retention of earlier functions require separate measurements.

items.name: EWC intervention
protocol_requirements: Declare context/boundary information, consolidation schedule, Fisher estimate and reference parameters.
Account for additional memory and any replay/context-specific heads.
caveats: Task boundaries and task identities are privileges that must match the intended setting.

items.name: Multi-Agent PPO (MAPPO)
protocol_requirements: Pin centralized critic inputs and decentralized actor information separately.
Declare shared versus unshared policies, role IDs, active/death masks and recurrence.
Count joint transitions, per-agent actions, vector environments and total updates separately.
caveats: No native MARL implementation or qualified integration is included.
A central critic does not authorize global-state input to the execution actor.

items.name: Independent PPO (IPPO)
protocol_requirements: Declare local value inputs and shared versus unshared parameters.
Preserve each agent reward/advantage convention and actor information permissions.
Report independent trained-team seeds, not agents within one team, as outer repetitions.
caveats: Independent learning does not necessarily mean unshared parameters.
No native implementation; the linked MAPPO repository is a public implementation route, not a certified reproduction of the separate IPPO paper.

items.name: QMIX
protocol_requirements: Pin joint reward, state-conditioned mixer and local utility networks.
Test monotonic mixing and valid-action masks with a small joint-action table.
Preserve agent identities, episode replay boundaries and target-network clocks.
caveats: Monotonic factorization restricts joint value representation.
No native implementation or author-code reproduction is claimed.

items.name: Value-Decomposition Networks (VDN)
protocol_requirements: Declare common team reward and additive utility decomposition.
Record policy sharing, role inputs and any communication.
Use independent trained teams and fixed cross-play population definitions.
caveats: Agent-wise utilities are not uniquely identified causal contributions.
No native implementation; PyMARL is an implementation reference rather than this workbench verification.

items.name: Multi-Agent DDPG (MADDPG)
protocol_requirements: Specify cooperative/competitive/general-sum rewards and critic joint inputs.
Pin replay joint-transition alignment, actor updates, target networks and action adaptation.
Declare opponent policy pool, snapshot sampling and opponent-training cost.
caveats: Historical source/API compatibility needs an explicitly qualified adapter.
Neither a win rate against one opponent nor centralized training proves equilibrium convergence.
